login_alias_operation_id.reason: Written together with a new alias by the admin alias update; an absent value only means no update is in flight.

role.reason: Maintained by the app_user_roles trigger since migration 20260215000800. Synchronization of rows older than the trigger is not verified by any command.

must_change_password.reason: An absent value reads as false; accounts without a temporary password need no data.

temp_password_expires_at.reason: An absent value reads as not expired; it is written together with each temporary password.

prerequisites.summary: Every account that logs in by alias has the alias in app_metadata.login_alias; login never reads user_metadata.

production.evidence: Owner patch 20261109_auth_login_alias_app_metadata_backfill.sql (PR #880) applied on release 5716c7c24 with UPDATE 28.
